directions.name: Editorial clarity
directions.notes: Warm paper, architectural type, and a single orange signal make the work feel considered and approachable.

interface.label: SELECTED PROJECT / 001
interface.title: Spaces to think differently.
interface.description: A new perspective on the everyday.

goal.what: Landing page hero for an independent design studio.
goal.audience: Founders and creative teams looking for a thoughtful digital partner.
goal.successCriteria: Explain the studio quickly, establish trust, and lead visitors to selected work.

format.canvas: Desktop-first hero within a 1240px container; responsive at tablet and mobile widths.
format.safeMargins: Fluid outer gutters of 18–60px; 55px vertical hero padding on desktop.

layout.grid: Two-column split, copy on the left and a framed project visual on the right.
layout.placement: Navigation above; eyebrow, headline, description, and actions left; project study right; metadata below.
layout.hierarchy: Headline → project visual → primary action → description → metadata.

typeSystem.display: Georgia serif, oversized with tight tracking and a compact line height.
typeSystem.metadata: System monospace, 10px uppercase with wide tracking.
typeSystem.contrast: Large display type against small utility labels and a restrained body size.

colorMaterial.surfaces: Soft cream #f5f3ec for the inset project visual.
colorMaterial.borders: Consistent 1px sage-gray #c9ccc3 hairlines; no drop shadows.
colorMaterial.signal: One terracotta accent #c95536 for the eyebrow, action, and visual detail.

copy.headline: Make room for a better idea.
copy.subtitle: We build thoughtful digital experiences for ambitious people and the things they believe in.

constraints.font: Editorial serif display with system sans body; keep headline tracking tight.
constraints.accent: Only terracotta #c95536; do not add other signal colors.
constraints.container: 1240px maximum, 4px corner radius, 1px borders, zero drop shadows.

negativePrompt: No purple gradients or multi-color highlights.
No floating cards with blurred shadows.
No generic pill buttons or extra decorative widgets.
No invented copy beyond the supplied text.

directions.name: Signal field
directions.notes: A centered, high-contrast composition lets a single electric-lime geometric form carry the visual identity.

goal.what: Alternative landing page hero for the same design studio.
goal.audience: Technology teams seeking a bold, focused creative collaborator.
goal.successCriteria: Make the studio memorable and draw attention to its project portfolio.

format.canvas: Centered desktop hero with a wide 16:9 visual; mobile stacks vertically.
format.safeMargins: 1160px maximum content width with responsive outer gutters.

layout.grid: One-column centered composition with a broad visual band below the copy.
layout.placement: Navigation at top, centered title and actions, abstract geometry below, utility footer at base.
layout.hierarchy: Headline → bright geometric visual → primary action → supporting line.

typeSystem.display: Boldly scaled Arial/Helvetica sans with tight tracking.
typeSystem.contrast: Oversized display type against micro utility type.

colorMaterial.foundation: Deep green-black #101916 with soft off-white ink #f1f3e9.
colorMaterial.signal: One electric lime #b8ec71 on actions and a single abstract object.

copy.headline: Ideas should change the room.
copy.subtitle: A creative practice bringing clarity, energy, and intention to every digital experience.

constraints.font: Modern sans display and body with high headline-to-label contrast.
constraints.container: 1160px maximum; squared 2px framing; no drop shadows.

negativePrompt: No colorful gradients or decorative icon clusters.
No floating cards, pill buttons, or soft shadows.
No additional callouts inside the visual band.
No replacement or shortened headline copy.

directions.name: Quiet archive
directions.notes: A tall, image-led editorial layout with ink-blue type and a precise cobalt accent leaves space for the work to speak.

visual.imageAlt: Light-filled studio interior with a long shared table
visual.caption: NOTES FROM THE STUDIO

goal.what: Image-led editorial hero for an independent design studio.
goal.audience: Art directors and brand teams evaluating the studio's taste and craft.
goal.successCriteria: Put the visual work first without losing a clear studio proposition.

format.canvas: Desktop editorial composition within 1280px; tall portrait media, stacked on mobile.
format.safeMargins: Fluid outer gutters and a deliberate gap between copy and media.

layout.grid: Asymmetric two-column editorial grid with a taller media column.
layout.placement: Headline left with actions beneath; portrait photograph right; section markers at edges.
layout.hierarchy: Headline → documentary image → subtitle → understated action.

typeSystem.display: Classic Times New Roman serif in an oversized, tightly tracked setting.
typeSystem.metadata: 10px uppercase system monospace for coordinates and section labels.
typeSystem.contrast: Editorial display scale with restrained small metadata.

colorMaterial.foundation: Pale gray paper #f0efe9 with dark ink-blue #202b35.
colorMaterial.signal: Single cobalt #2459af accent on the eyebrow and action.

copy.headline: A practice in seeing differently.
copy.subtitle: Distinctive places, identities, and experiences begin with the way we look at things.

constraints.font: Classic serif display, serif body, and monospaced metadata.
constraints.accent: Only cobalt #2459af; keep photography natural and untreated.

negativePrompt: No stock iconography or overlapping floating cards.
No heavy gradients or shadows on the image.
No extra sections or invented testimonials.
No pill buttons or additional accent colors.
